analysis.appended_sensitivity: rank canonical e-ATS among all 21 archived rows, yielding 22 rows
analysis.cell_estimand: mean terminal normalized dynamic pseudo-regret over all 250 paired tape groups in a family-by-geometry cell
analysis.cell_weighting: 18 family-by-geometry cells receive equal weight in the mean and median rank summaries
analysis.primary_leaderboard: replace e_authorized_mean_gate with canonical e-ATS; retain the other 20 archived rows
analysis.rank_rule: competition rank: one plus the number of policy cell means strictly below the target mean; exact ties share the best occupied rank

runtime_bridge.change_from_v1: operational source reconstruction only; environment hashes, policy, seeds, tapes, comparators, estimands, and ranking are unchanged

scientific_role: secondary post-freeze no-retuning transfer replay; not an untouched confirmatory superiority test
seed_and_tape_contract: For every historical group, canonical e-ATS receives the exact archived mean table, potential-reward tape, and policy-seed descriptor. Archived comparators are not rerun.

tuning_fairness.archived_baselines: Historical coordinates and outcomes are retained exactly. Tunable historical algorithms were selected under their original independently registered grids and development streams; parameter-free rows had no tuning.
tuning_fairness.canonical_e_ats: The frozen public entry point has no exposed policy coordinate. No parameter, environment, seed, subset, or aggregation choice may be tuned or selected using this replay.
tuning_fairness.interpretation: Development histories and search-space sizes are heterogeneous, so equal tuning-budget parity is not established. The no-retuning current row is a conservative transfer comparison against already tuned specialists.
prohibited: changing the canonical policy or freeze
selecting a current e-ATS variant from replay outcomes
dropping environments, seeds, tapes, or comparator rows
changing cell weights or the rank/tie rule
